findings.state: implementation patched; native execution recorded; final-source qualification tracked in l2-proof
findings.invariant: Source-event replay must preserve original publication identity through the public SDK, observation, and activation callers
findings.evidence: Dispatcher returns original receipt for retargeted event. SDK binding and lexical receipt validation require new request generation/digest; observation requires both requested and receipt identity. Response carries no original revision.
findings.repair: Required SourcePublicationBinding from immutable catalog original; request-bound observation; SDK source/receipt binding and activation from original snapshot; remove unbound receipt conversion.

findings.state: implementation patched; native execution recorded; final-source qualification tracked in l2-proof
findings.invariant: One containing repo/revision/generation belongs to at most one source event in both live admission and persisted recovery
findings.evidence: reserve_source_event rejects duplicate target generation; validate_history and decode validate lineage but do not enforce target uniqueness across event rows.
findings.repair: validate_history now rejects repeated physical generation slots in encode/decode; production reopen regression added

findings.state: Owner and public-contract test oracles patched and executed
findings.invariant: Negative file-owner tests must not pass through unrelated stale digest rejection
findings.evidence: Lexical path/definition fixtures changed units without recomputing unit_set_sha256; generic is_err assertions admitted that alternative rejection. Materializer path fixture had the same issue. Clear/tombstone lexical fixtures also retained old event payload digests.
findings.repair: Refresh applicable unit/event commitments; assert valid batch shape and exact expected mutation conflict before asserting zero writes.

findings.state: implementation patched; native execution recorded; final-source qualification tracked in l2-proof
findings.invariant: Full replacement with a matching sealed identity can reach the existing content-corruption repair planner; damaged content remains unreadable and unbuildable before explicit reclamation
findings.evidence: Real adapter preflight walked all sealed content before the materializer repair plan; fake-builder recovery fixtures did not exercise that obstruction.
findings.repair: Only matching-identity ReplaceGeneration plus typed GenerationSidecarCorrupt may pass mutation preflight; other failures and Delta remain rejected. Existing identity-fenced materializer repair remains the owner.
findings.exclusion: Real adapter boundary only; composed materializer/catalog behavior NOT_RUN

findings.state: implementation patched; native execution recorded; final-source qualification tracked in l2-proof
findings.invariant: Recovery/provider fixtures must pass valid admission before reaching their intended oracle
findings.evidence: fixture_chunk_record and chunk_record_v used fixed end_byte=24 despite different text lengths; mode/clear mutations kept stale source-event payload commitments; semantic receipt fixture replaced and tombstoned one owner.
findings.repair: Use actual UTF-8 byte length, validate baseline fixtures, restamp event/transport commitments after content changes, and separate receipt-counter owners. Also corrected semantic_derive fixture_chunk byte length after 17 native failures.

findings.state: implementation patched; native execution recorded; final-source qualification tracked in l2-proof
findings.invariant: A target repair-mode refusal before any track mutation must not durably consume a producer stream slot
findings.evidence: Dispatcher reserves before apply; direct materializer also reserves before sealed physical planning and repair mode check. A valid Delta over a corrupt semantic target is refused only by repair_corrupt_v1, leaving a Pending source reservation; a later full publication then conflicts. The existing corrupt-track direct test expects Delta refusal followed by full rebuild but inspects neither source reservation nor the dispatcher reservation sibling.
findings.repair: Materializer alone reserves under its operation lock after physical repair-mode and pure semantic stream admission, before discard/reclaim/provider/build. Dispatcher retains replay and reconciliation without early reservation.
findings.post_patch_proof: Source and scoped formatting only; no compilation or native test run
exclusions: Abort/release after partial or uncertain work

findings.state: implementation patched; native execution recorded; final-source qualification tracked in l2-proof
findings.invariant: An error after source materialization starts cannot freeze the original journal as a terminal nonpublication refusal while retaining its Pending stream reservation
findings.evidence: publish_idempotent records every typed apply error as Refused. publish_source_idempotent replays that terminal refusal forever, while the activation catalog retains Pending and disallows a successor. For example, repair_corrupt_v1 returns typed GenerationConflict while a reader still pins the corrupt target, after the event has reserved; releasing that reader cannot retry the frozen journal. InvalidContract attempts record_refused too, but that port accepts typed refusals only and the ignored error can leave Applying instead of Uncertain.
findings.repair: Source apply errors use Uncertain; transient source preflight errors retain Prepared; both preserve Pending source binding for fenced recovery.
findings.post_patch_proof: Source trace and scoped format checks only
exclusions: Previously stored terminal Refused rows are not migrated
Real physical adapter and installed-process recovery

findings.invariant: Readers retain acknowledged paired snapshot while a repository publication waits for parent fsync
findings.evidence: Existing activation and rollback parent-sync tests failed while entries write lock blocked read, causing sync timeout. Separate publication writer mutex now retains serial mutation without blocking snapshot reads; poisoned writer fences reads and writes.

findings.invariant: A retry preflight error after uncertain materialization cannot terminally refuse an original Pending source event
findings.repair: Source mutable preflight refusals retain Prepared; source apply refusals retain Uncertain. Extended source_event_apply_errors_retry_the_original_journal_without_retargeting checks a transient preflight failure before successful recovery.
